primary_decisions.title: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
primary_decisions.problem: 总分提升可能掩盖同一家族发布模型在特定子任务上的退步。
primary_decisions.insight: 用相同问题上的双向正确性翻转衡量净退步，再区分候选筛选、多重检验和提示协议的影响。
primary_decisions.method: 19 released VLMs in four families, eight benchmarks/nine splits; 10,434 eligible within-family comparisons with at least 20 questions; net flip threshold five. Direct zero-shot greedy generation; paired CoT retest of both models on the 375 selected cases.
primary_decisions.result: 375 screened cases; 16 survive BH correction across all 10,434 eligible comparisons. CoT leaves 96/375 above the same net-five threshold under a different generation budget.
primary_decisions.limitation: 发布模型的训练、编码器与对齐存在混淆；375是比较案例而非独立任务。CoT较长预算和小模型下降也会改变差值；统计筛选及重叠比较限制因果/总体解释。不能据此断言参数增加造成逆向缩放。
primary_decisions.sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–5.5, selected §6 and limitations; Appendix A decoding/model table, selected B family tables, D multiple testing, E cross-family table, I active-parameter constraints, J option-order controls, K encoder tiers, L paired CoT design. Did not fully audit error taxonomy/human annotations, all case tables, code or figure pixels.
primary_decisions.evidence_status: Primary selected-section review; no independent experimental reproduction or full version/code audit.
primary_decisions.changes_existing_conclusion: T7 adds subtask-level evaluation as a boundary of aggregate multimodal progress; does not overturn aggregate scaling.
evidence_notes: BH denominator 10,434 yields 16; correcting only the 375 selected cases yields 54 and is not the adopted headline.
Most eligible comparisons favor larger models; 87% of 171 affected family-subtasks are non-monotonic.
CoT reruns both models, increases max tokens from 2048 to 4096, and smaller-model accuracy falls in 251/375 cases; attenuation is not all larger-model recovery.
Option-order audit covers only six strong BLINK cases, not all 375.
Total-parameter ordering mixes dense/MoE; Appendix I sensitivity checks do not supply matched independently trained recipes.
Code link https://github.com/saxenarohit/vlm_inverse_scaling observed in paper but not executed.
